title: Oceanfront Seasonal RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Oceanfront Seasonal RV Trailer Park is on Nova Scotia’s Northumberland Shore, just a few miles from Merigomish & Melmerby Beach, along the picturesque “Sunrise Trail”. These are the balmy waters of the Northumberland Strait, between PEI & Nova Scotia - the warmest ocean water temperatures north of Virginia, sometimes reaching 25°C, or 77°F.
